title: buildproject.expired payload
description: Payload emitted by the BuildProject lifecycle enforcer when an ephemeral BuildProject transitions from 'active' to 'expiring' because its expires_at has passed.

expires_at.description: Original expires_at value as stored on the BuildProject (RFC 3339 or empty).

teardown_workflow_ref.description: Optional reference to the workflow the enforcer dispatched (or will dispatch) to clean up this BuildProject's resources.
